message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play a pre‑agreed number of rounds). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and then scoring the value of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On a turn you may:
1. **Play** one card from your hand that matches the discard pile’s color, number, or symbol.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot or choose not to play. | | **Playable Cards** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – match by number or color.
• **Action cards** – match by color or symbol.
• **Wild cards** – can be played on any card. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Wild Draw Four Rules** | • May only be played if you have no playable card of the current color.
• If challenged and you were allowed to play it, the challenger draws four cards instead. | | **Drawing** | • If you draw a playable card, you may play it immediately.
• If you cannot play after drawing, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn.
• Failure to call UNO when required results in a penalty: draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card.
• That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. The first player to reach 500 points wins the game (or the agreed target). | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack +2 or +4 cards instead of drawing.
• **Custom rules** – e.g., “Draw 5” cards for certain actions.
• **House rules** – e.g., “No wild cards” or “All cards must be matched by number.” | **Quick Play Summary** 1. Deal 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card to start discard pile. 3. Clockwise play: match color/number/symbol or play a wild. 4. Action cards affect the next player. 5. Call “UNO” with one card left. 6. Round ends when someone discards all cards; score. 7. First to 500 points (or set target) wins. Enjoy your game!
